verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a first-party way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. AgentOS runs multi-step workflows on demand, and the CLI can 'script repeatable tasks', but any scheduling would rely on the user's external tooling such as cron, which is a user-side workaround. Recurring invoices and multi-frequency subscriptions are domain billing schedules, an adjacent feature rather than a general recurring job or workflow scheduler.
